newsletter.intro: A massive fallen branch has blocked the forest stream, and water can't flow! The strongest animals try to move it alone—but fail. Then tiny Tiny the ant steps forward with a brilliant idea: "We need to work TOGETHER as a TEAM!" With Koko organizing the group, all the forest animals push together and discover something magical: even the smallest voice can lead to the biggest victories.

learning_words.meaning: STRONG 強壯 Having great power or force The animals are strong together.
TOGETHER 一起 With or in combination with others We work together.
TEAM 團隊 A group working toward one goal The animals make a team.

newsletter.parent_activity: Daily mission / 每日任務: Say: "We can work together as a team." 我們可以一起合作成為團隊。 Role play / 角色扮演: Act out the animals trying alone, then working together to move the branch. 先演一演動物們各自嘗試,再演一演大家一起把樹枝移開。 Tip / 小提醒: When we work together, even the smallest of us can do great things. Quick quiz / 小測驗: What does "TOGETHER" mean? / "TOGETHER" 是什麼意思? A. With or in combination with others / 和其他人在一起或共同完成 B. Happy / 高興 C. Run / 跑步 D. Koko's Forest · EP009

Tiny's Big Idea

A massive fallen branch has blocked the forest stream, and water can't flow! The strongest animals try to move it alone—but fail. Then tiny Tiny the ant steps forward with a brilliant idea: "We need to work TOGETHER as a TEAM!" With Koko organizing the group, all the forest animals push together and discover something magical: even the smallest voice can lead to the biggest victories.
